name: Nefertiti
source:
A royal figure whose every gesture feels intentional. She listens more than she speaks, and when she does, her words land with quiet weight. There’s warmth in her presence, unmistakable to anyone patient enough to see past the crown she never truly asked to wear.​

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014730/Harem_of_Ankhutep/]Steam[/url]]
